## Typst Document Format

| Position | Content |
|---|---|
| Top | Amity University logo |
| Upper middle | University name |
| Centre | Large photograph of the university campus |
| Below photograph | Report title |
| Below title | Subtitle or reporting period |
| Bottom | Education Data Analytics Department |
| Footer | Report generation date |

## Typst provides Several Layouts

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `#pagebreak()` | Start a new page |
| `#align()` | Align content left, centre, or right |
| `#image()` | Insert a photograph or logo |
| `#text()` | Control font size, colour, and weight |
| `#v()` | Insert vertical space |
| `#h()` | Insert horizontal space |
| `#rect()` | Draw a rectangle |
| `#block()` | Create a content container |
| `#grid()` | Arrange elements in columns |
| `#place()` | Position elements relative to an anchor |


```{=typst}
#import "QT_cover0.typ": university-cover

#university-cover(
  title: "Admissions Analytics Report by Dhiraj",
  subtitle: "Academic Year 2026–27",
  image-path: "auupl.jpeg",
  department: "Education Data Analytics",
  report-date: "October 2026",
)
```

```{=typst}
#import "@preview/fontawesome:0.6.2": fa-icon

#fa-icon("graduation-cap", solid: true) Student Admissions

#v(5mm)

#fa-icon("chart-line", solid: true, fill: blue) Admissions Trends

#v(5mm)

#fa-icon("users", solid: true, fill: green) Student Enrolment
```
